translations.answer: The repository has been fixed to use 19 degrees of freedom (DoF) for the H1 path, initializing dof_pos from 27 to 19 and aligning the joint name list to 19 entries. The fix should use commits after 0c6fd6f and verify the model's DoF count; custom robots cannot arbitrarily change to 19 without aligning DoF vectors, rotation axes, and joint order.
translations.applicability: Directly applicable to the Unitree H1 legacy retargeting script prior to 0c6fd6f; other robots should follow dimension consistency principles.
translations.credibility.rationale: The issue has been closed, the environment is clear and consistent, and there is formal documentation or independent reproducible exact reference.
translations.details.attempts.0: Community users linked a temporary modification; the questioner replied that it works; the maintainer then released a formal repository update.
translations.details.diagnostics.0: The H1_ROTATION_AXIS axis count, the last dimension of dof_pos, and the order of h1_joint_names were all verified outside of torch.cat.
translations.details.effective_fixes.0: Commit 0c6fd6f updated grad_fit_h1_shape.py to change dof_pos from torch.zeros((1,27)) to torch.zeros((1,19)) and align the H1 joint list to 19 entries.
translations.details.environments.0: LeCAR-Lab/human2humanoid; original script used on 2024-10-05; fixed commit 0c6fd6f2a7c0a3974cc2856db1eabb72896b88cd.
translations.details.limits.0: 19 is the dimension for the H1 model and this script; it is not a universal constant for all custom robots. Dimension changes must synchronize joint order and rotation axes.
translations.details.outcomes.0: A collaborator confirmed the latest version is fixed and closed the issue; the diff precisely covers the error line.
translations.details.problem_statements.0: What is the correct dimension for the H1_ROTATION_AXIS and dof_pos when multiplying them?
translations.details.suspected_causes.0: The old script had H1_ROTATION_AXIS as 19 axes, but dof_pos was initialized as 27 dimensions.
translations.details.symptoms.0: RuntimeError: The size of tensor a (19) must match the size of tensor b (27) at non-singleton dimension 1.
translations.source.locator: Issue #4; collaborator replies to issuecomment-2516365741; fixed commit 0c6fd6f 27→19
translations.source.title: Old grad_fit_h1_shape.py uses 19-axis H1_ROTATION_AXIS with 27-dim dof_pos
translations.title: When H1_ROTATION_AXIS is 19 axes and dof_pos is 27 dimensions, how to fix it without masking the mapping error?
